name: context_agent
functionality: Generates a concise Customer Return Summary (order, product, return details) as a structured markdown narrative from raw JSON input fields. Translates Hinglish, formats variables (variant, delivery type, timing), and outputs a templated summary.
inputs: 60+ fields: order_id, return_id, product_title, listing_price, basket_size, payment type, membership_tier, new_customer_profile, color, size, package_contents, service_profile, courier_name, obd_flag, vms_flag, is_seller_packing_video_available, delivery_date_to_promise_date, return_reason, return_sub_reason, return_comments, return_action, previous_non_comment_mismatch_return_rejection_count, ri_flag, order_item_quantity, etc.
promptDescription: Version 5.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-04-02). Role: E-commerce Customer Support AI Assistant. Purpose: Generate Customer Return Summary. Tasks: Compute 5 variables (comment_text, variant_details, delivery_description, formatted_return_sub_reason, delivery_timing_text) then populate markdown JSON template with order_summary, product_summary, return_summary sections.
evaluationClasses: match (generates narrative summary - no classification label)
decisionOutput: {"decision": <string|null>, "analysis": <string>} - analysis contains the full markdown narrative summary of order + product + return details
